recommendations.thesis: Semiconductor leader with AI capex tailwind. Relatively resilient in selloff (-1.37% vs AMD -6.49%). SMH futures +17% signals massive semi bounce. Supply chain is diversified vs pure China plays. If any tariff resolution comes, semis snap back hardest.
recommendations.catalyst: Tariff de-escalation catalyst, AI spending resilience, oversold bounce
recommendations.risks: Continued tariff escalation hits hardware supply chains. VIX 40+ means violent swings both ways.

recommendations.thesis: Most oversold mega-cap (-4.98%) due to direct China manufacturing exposure. This is exactly why it bounces hardest on ANY tariff resolution. Services revenue (60%+ margin) unaffected by tariffs. Massive buyback program provides floor. At 172 this is approaching valuations not seen since mid-2024.
recommendations.catalyst: Tariff pause/negotiation, oversold technical bounce, buyback support
recommendations.risks: Tariffs sustained = material margin hit from China manufacturing. Could see 160 if crisis deepens.

recommendations.thesis: Down -6.49%, significantly more than NVDA (-1.37%), creating a catch-up trade. AI data center demand is structural and tariff-independent. AMD's fab partner TSMC is in Taiwan not China. The 6.5% drop prices in worst-case that likely doesn't materialize for this name specifically.
recommendations.catalyst: Oversold bounce, AI spending announcements, tariff de-escalation
recommendations.risks: Broader semiconductor export controls. Continued market-wide deleveraging.

recommendations.thesis: Up +2.91% while everything else crashed. Defense is the ultimate tariff hedge - revenue is US government, no trade exposure. Geopolitical tensions (trade war = geopolitical instability) are bullish for defense spending. If crisis continues, LMT keeps outperforming. If crisis resolves, LMT holds gains. Asymmetric setup.
recommendations.catalyst: Continued geopolitical tension, defense budget visibility, flight to quality
recommendations.risks: Sharp risk-on reversal could see rotation OUT of defensives. But downside is limited given government revenue certainty.

recommendations.thesis: Gold is THE crisis asset. Up +3.23% while equities crashed. Dollar weakening (-1.97%) is directly bullish for gold. Bond market turmoil (10Y spiking on forced selling, not growth optimism) drives safe haven flows. Central bank buying continues. Gold works in BOTH scenarios: crisis continues = more flight to safety; crisis resolves = dollar stays weak from tariff damage.
recommendations.catalyst: Continued dollar weakness, bond market stress, central bank buying, CPI tomorrow
recommendations.risks: Sharp dollar reversal on tariff resolution. But gold has been trending higher for months regardless.

recommendations.thesis: Down -3.78% and airlines (JETS -3.61%) massively oversold on recession fears. But DAL reports earnings THIS WEEK and is expected to beat on strong travel demand. Oil crash (-3.66% WTI) is DIRECTLY bullish for airline margins. If tariff fears ease even slightly, airlines snap back hard as recession probability reprices lower. Oil at $60 = massive fuel cost tailwind.
recommendations.catalyst: Earnings beat, oil price collapse helping margins, tariff de-escalation
recommendations.risks: Recession materializes and kills travel demand. But at 35.88 the stock prices in significant demand destruction already.

recommendations.thesis: Up +2.68% in the crash, confirming defensive leadership alongside LMT. RTX has both defense AND commercial aerospace exposure. Tariffs don't impact defense contracts. Commercial aerospace backlog is multi-year. At 120.46 trading at reasonable multiple for a business with decade-long order visibility.
recommendations.catalyst: Defense spending momentum, commercial aerospace backlog, crisis safe haven flows
recommendations.risks: Broad market liquidation event could drag down even defensives temporarily.
